title: $5M condo shatters Provincetown's real estate record
summary_full: Provincetown's real estate market has reached new heights, with two condos selling for remarkable prices recently. Notably, a chic three-bedroom home sold for an eye-popping five million dollars, establishing a record for condo sales in the area. As demand skyrockets, buyers are drawn to the allure of contemporary living and resort-like comforts in this sought-after destination, amidst a backdrop of limited housing availability.
